Demonology Warlock

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated November 13, 2026 · Client build 1.60.1.70938 · Null Ossuary

A guide to the live game, 1 to 60, on client 1.60.1.70938 with hotfixes through November 12. The talent order is Icy Veins' published one; Wowhead's build is described from its own text. Levels assume no Legacy TalentedTalentedTalentCastInstantYou gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points.. Demon Health changed three times around launch and the page gives the current state. Wowhead's Demonology rotation and stat pages predate launch (October 26 and November 3) and its stat page calls its own order a best estimate. No raid opens until December 9, so the level-60 section rests on guides and on WoWSims' model, not on logs.

What Demonology is for

A demon that carries part of the fight. Unholy PowerUnholy PowerTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases all damage done by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter pets by 10%. raises all its damage by 10%. Demonic EnergiesDemonic EnergiesTalent · Rank 2 of 2CastInstantYou heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain. heals it for 15% of the spell damage you deal and passes it all the Mana from your Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantConverts 30 Health into 30 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted.. Fel VitalityFel VitalityTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstantIncreases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%. gives it 15% more Health and Mana and gives you 15% more Mana.

It comes together at 25 to 27 with Demonic BrandDemonic BrandTalent · Rank 3 of 3CastInstant. Searing PainSearing PainLevel 18 · Spell · Fire · Rank 1 of 6Cast1.5 sec castCost45 ManaRange30 yd rangeInflict searing pain on the enemy target, causing 24 to 29 Fire damage. Causes a high amount of threat. brands the target for 10 seconds, and your demon's next attacks on it deal extra damage, two per talent point. Wowhead: until then Demonology "plays like a weaker Affliction", and from then on the demon does a large share of the damage and holds threat well.

At 40, Demonic PactDemonic PactTalentCastInstantYour Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect. lets you keep a Demonic SacrificeDemonic SacrificeSpell · ShadowCastInstantRange100 yd rangeWhen activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 7200 sec. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned. Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%. Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec. Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%. Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec. bonus with a different demon out. Sacrifice the Imp for +15% Shadow damage, then summon the Succubus or Incubus.

CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 7Cast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secCorrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec. keeps its 2-second cast in both published orders until the Affliction points arrive in the 40s.

Icy Veins rates the spec 5 out of 5 for levelling and 4 for dungeons (November 9). A levelling score measures solo kill speed and nothing else. Wowhead's costs: the early talents do little before 25, and losing your demon costs its damage, Soul LinkSoul LinkSpell · ShadowCastInstantCost20% of base ManaRange100 yd rangeWhen active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active. and the time to summon it again.

Your talent points

Both guide sites publish a 1 to 60 levelling build with 31 points in Demonology and 20 in Affliction. Icy Veins prints its order point by point. Wowhead shows its build as an interactive calculator and describes it in words.

Wowhead's build (November 6). The build itself is a calculator on Wowhead's levelling page; the page prints no point-by-point order. Its text: "Every early point goes into your demon, with the big steps at Demonic Brand (25 to 27) and Demonic Pact (40). Your last 20 points go into Affliction, for instant Corruption, more mana from Life Tap, and a stronger Drain Life." Stat priority

Wowhead (November 3, from sim stat weights, and by its own word a best estimate for 60): Spell Power, or Fire or Shadow damage matching your build, then Hit, critical strike, Haste, Spell Pierce, Intellect, Spirit.

Icy Veins (November 4): Hit to the cap, then Spell Power, critical strike, Haste, Intellect.

  • Hit ranks higher here than for the other two specs. Wowhead: your demon uses your Hit chance, so each miss you remove helps both of you. The cap is 17% against raid bosses and 4% against an enemy of your own level. Wowhead's raid builds take a single point of SuppressionSuppressionTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%., so nearly all of it comes from gear.
  • Spell Power reaches the demon too. Wowhead: the demon scales from your Spell Power. Blizzard gives one ratio only, 2 Health per point of your Stamina.
  • Haste speeds up your casts, not the demon's.
  • Spirit adds 1 Mana per point to every Life TapLife TapLevel 6 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantConverts 30 Health into 30 Mana for you. Spirit increases the amount converted., and Demonic EmbraceDemonic EmbraceTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantIncreases your total Stamina by 15%. no longer reduces it.
